label: Oceans surface temperature
description: Ocean currents colored by water temperature, from cold blue at the poles to warm red at the equator.
hear: Warm water plays high notes. Cold water plays low notes.

label: Lightning
description: Lightning flashes detected from the International Space Station between 2017 and 2023.
hear: Each burst of lightning triggers notes. More flashes play more notes.

label: Carbon monoxide
description: Carbon monoxide in the atmosphere, from pale yellow for clean air to dark red for heavy pollution from fires and industry.
hear: More pollution plays higher notes. Sudden changes sound louder.

label: Plants density
description: Vegetation across the continents through the seasons, from gray for bare ground to bright green for dense plant life.
hear: Denser vegetation plays higher notes. Bare ground plays low notes.

label: Aerosols
description: Tiny particles in the atmosphere on 19 August 2025: desert dust, wildfire smoke, sea salt and sulfates.
hear: Each particle type has its own instrument: strings for smoke, vibraphone for dust, music box for sea salt and a soft pad for sulfates. Louder means more of it.
